CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified contents.

COD.rationale: Content (red at p1/current/n2), an organization-like pattern and an explicit origin/status are all present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition is linked to the organization/presentation/access of the identified contents.

C.rationale: Multiple lines explicitly identify content attributes (red/blue) and their coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields are given separately from the red/blue content lists for the same referent.

O.rationale: The text states a coordinate orientation and shows organized coordinate sets for a referent, describing presentation/organization.
